mapper.sql: p.id, p.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile_image, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.content, p.image_url, p.reply_count, p.like_count, p.view_count, p.subscriber_only, p.created_at, p.updated_at

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_reaction pr_like JOIN common_code cc_like ON pr_like.type = cc_like.id WHERE pr_like.post_id = p.id AND pr_like.member_id = #{memberId} AND cc_like.code='LIKE') AS liked,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_reaction pr_scrap JOIN common_code cc_scrap ON pr_scrap.type = cc_scrap.id WHERE pr_scrap.post_id = p.id AND pr_scrap.member_id = #{memberId} AND cc_scrap.code = 'SCRAP') AS scrapped
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (member_id, category_id, content, image_url, subscriber_only) VALUES (#{memberId},#{categoryId},#{content},#{imageUrl},#{subscriberOnly})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM post p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.id JOIN common_code c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription s JOIN common_code c ON s.status_id = c.id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.type = 4 AND c.code = 'SS01')
